feedback:
1. (Judgment 4) At 360 the lead element, the first project title "Politweets", is not in fold 1. Only its "01 EXPERIMENT 2008" meta line sits at the bottom edge, and the title is cut onto fold 2. Tighten the masthead's bottom padding and move or compress the "Selected work / 2008 — 2026 / 07" summary block so the full Politweets title lands inside the first 640px. At 1440 it already sits fully in the fold, around y≈465–525.

2. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman row reads "A founder-built consumer product, taken from a blank page to a launched company — no permission asked." The records describe Spaceman as the LLC Doug has operated under since 2018. It covers independent product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand work for clients including Rolex, Intuit and LastPass. Replace the copy with a description drawn from the record.

3. (Judgment 5) The summary "Seven shipped experiments. None of them waited for permission." contradicts the records on two points. Spaceman is a Founder practice and the others are SaaS or AI products, while only TeeTurn, Politweets and Twittertale are typed Experiment. 15th Club's status is "In Development", not shipped. Reword it to something the records support, such as "Seven projects, 2008–2026."

4. (Judgment 3) The Type Treatment declares `case: caps` for the hero. The lead element is the list of project titles, and those are set in mixed case, so only the stepped-down quote is in caps. Set the project titles in caps so the declared case lands on the lead object.

The dare sits reversed out in a violet halftone masthead as a right-set caps standfirst, and directly beneath it the project titles in poster-scale heavy Zilla Slab lead the page from Politweets down to dougmar.ch, flush to a hard right edge, so the list visibly answers the quote at both widths.
